'''Arc welders''' were tools carried by [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]], such as the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2]] and [[R5-series astromech droid|R5-series]] as part of their standard equipment.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> Their main purpose was for repairing things, such as bulkheads, but creative droids could improvise to employ them for various other purposes. [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] used an arc welder to release [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] from her shackles on [[Khetanna/Legends|Jabba's Sail Barge]] in 4 ABY.
